fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on the prospects and governance of horse racing in Miami, including discussion of the Miami Jockey Club and concerns about corruption and legalization. Reports on a dispute over a city ordinance requiring dry cleaners and tailors to post a bond, with calls for repeal. Covers an incident on the Tamiami Trail involving arrests for killing an alligator during closed season and comments on local law enforcement. Notes on the Miami Basketball Club fundraising and upcoming games. Includes society and humor columns, letters to the editor, and a report urging protection for nurses following an assault connected to a fraudulent night call.
